arxiv-2212-09816.title: Proportional Control for Stochastic Regulation on Allocation of Multi-Robots
arxiv-2212-09816.creator: Thales C. Silva, Victoria Edwards, M. Ani Hsieh
arxiv-2212-09816.description: Abstract Any strategy used to distribute a robot ensemble over a set of sequential tasks is subject to inaccuracy due to robot-level uncertainties and environmental influences on the robots’ behavior. We approach the problem of inaccuracy during task allocation by modeling and controlling the overall ensemble behavior.

arxiv-2402-09853.title: Besov spaces in operator theory Thanks: The research on § 6-7 is supported by Russian Science Foundation [grant number 23-11-00153].
arxiv-2402-09853.creator: V.V. Peller
arxiv-2402-09853.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by V.V. Peller. The survey is devoted to diverse applications of Besov classes in operator theory. It is illustrated how Besov classes are used to describe Hankel operators of Schatten–von Neumann classes; various applications of this description are considered. Next, we discuss the role of Besov classes in norm estimates of polynomials of power bounded operators on Hilbert space and related estimates of Hankel matrices in tensor products of the spaces ℓ 1 \ell^{1} and ℓ ∞ \ell^{\infty} .

arxiv-2503-15737.title: KoGNER: A Novel Framework for Knowledge Graph Distillation on Biomedical Named Entity Recognition
arxiv-2503-15737.creator: Heming Zhang*, Wenyu Li*, Di Huang*, Yinjie Tang, Yixin Chen, Philip Payne, Fuhai Li†
arxiv-2503-15737.description: Abstract Named Entity Recognition (NER) is a fundamental task in Natural Language Processing (NLP) that plays a crucial role in information extraction, question answering, and knowledge-based systems. Traditional deep learning-based NER models often struggle with domain-specific generalization and suffer from data sparsity issues.

arxiv-2504-12168.title: A simple algorithm for the simple bilevel programming (SBP) problem
arxiv-2504-12168.creator: Stephan Dempe, Joydeep Dutta, Tanushree Pandit and K. S. Mallikarjuna Rao
arxiv-2504-12168.description: Abstract In this article we intend to develop a simple and implementable algorithm for minimizing a convex function over the solution set of another convex optimization problem. Such a problem is often referred to as a simple bilevel programming (SBP) problem.

pmc-10674185.creator: Xuanzhen Zhang, Yunhui Feng, Fangbao Fu, Huan Wang
pmc-10674185.description: High-performance ultraviolet photodetectors have important scientific research significance and practical application value, which has been the focus of researchers. In this work, we have constructed a highly photosensitive UV photodetector with a unique “sandwich” structure, which was mainly composed of two layers of ZnO nanosheet arrays and one layer of polyaniline (PANI).

pmc-12427714.title: Health Behaviors and Psychological Well-Being Among First-Year Psychology, Medicine, and Nursing Students: A Cross-Sectional Analysis
pmc-12427714.creator: Natacha Palenzuela-Luis, Gonzalo Duarte-Clíments, Juan Gómez-Salgado, José Ángel Rodríguez-Gómez, María Begoña Sánchez-Gómez, Wai Keung Leung, Florence Mei Fung Wong
pmc-12427714.description: Introduction: Understanding adolescent maturational development and its impact on physical and psychological well-being is essential for supporting the academic and professional growth of undergraduate students in Health Sciences programs (Psychology, Medicine, and Nursing). This study aimed to assess and compare self-concept, self-perception, physical activity, and lifestyle among first-year Health Sciences students.

pmc-12608401.title: Predictors for Using Electricity During Hysteroscopic Removal of Retained Products of Conception
pmc-12608401.creator: Liat Mor, Tzvi Leibowitz, Emilie Ben-Ezry, Ram Kerner, Ran Keidar, Eran Weiner, Ron Sagiv, Ohad Gluck, Raanan Meyer
pmc-12608401.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: Retained products of conception (RPOC) can be managed via hysteroscopic removal using mechanical or electrosurgical techniques. Electrosurgery introduces greater technical complexity and may reflect more adherent or vascular tissue, yet preoperative predictors for its necessity remain poorly defined. Objective: The objective of this study was to evaluate clinical outcomes and identify preoperative predictors associated with the use of electrosurgery during hysteroscopic removal of RPOC.

pmc-12652468.title: Maintenance of Mental Health: The Role of Physical Activity Among Young Adults
pmc-12652468.creator: Luca Szabó, Bettina F Piko, Daniele Giansanti
pmc-12652468.description: Background: Young adults, particularly university students, are at increased risk for psychological distress and burnout. Regular physical activity is widely recognized as a protective factor for mental health. This study aimed to compare physically active and inactive college students in terms of perceived stress, well-being, burnout, and resilience.

pmc-12655502.title: Pattern Recognition Algorithms in Pharmacogenomics and Drug Repurposing—Case Study: Ribavirin and Lopinavir
pmc-12655502.creator: Hiram Calvo, Diana Islas-Díaz, Eduardo Hernández-Laureano, Anna Artese
pmc-12655502.description: Pattern recognition and machine learning algorithms have become integral to modern drug discovery, offering powerful tools to uncover complex patterns in biomedical data. This article provides a comprehensive review of state-of-the-art pattern recognition techniques—including traditional machine learning (e.g., support vector machines), deep learning approaches, genome-wide association studies (GWAS), and biomarker discovery methods—as applied in pharmacogenomics and computational drug repurposing.

pmc-13200369.title: A ROS-responsive core–shell microneedle platform integrating sonodynamic gas antibacterial therapy and modulating immunity for diabetic wound healing
pmc-13200369.creator: Pinkai Wang, Fanrong Ai, Guanfeng Huang, Yunfeng Shen, Fengyang Cui, Hui Deng, Chengzhi Liang, Jiajun Xie, Jiawei Kang, Yudan Zhu, Weixiang Xiong, Jun Tao
pmc-13200369.description: Chronic diabetic wounds complicated by biofilm infections resist healing because persistent bacterial colonization coexists with microenvironmental imbalances, including oxidative stress and inflammation. Conventional pharmacotherapy and wound care are limited by impaired local perfusion, which hinders both effective biofilm eradication and reversal of the pathological wound microenvironment.

pmc-13258694.title: Immunonutritional Indices, Inflammatory Markers, and Thyroid-Related Parameters in Adults with Hashimoto’s Thyroiditis
pmc-13258694.creator: Hulya Yilmaz Onal, Songul Aktas, Aysun Yuksel, Tutku Tuncalı Yaman, Ozcan Keskin, Hafize Uzun
pmc-13258694.description: Background: Hashimoto’s thyroiditis (HT) is a chronic autoimmune disorder characterized not only by thyroid dysfunction but also by metabolic disturbances, micronutrient inadequacies, and low-grade inflammation. Composite indices derived from routine laboratory parameters may therefore help capture the broader systemic profile of the disease.
